logistics.title: Logistics
logistics.enable_hint: Enable logistics for listings handled by an agent at the customer's location — deliveries, equipment hire, transport, set-up and teardown. When on, listings gain a "Needs logistics" option and logistics agents can be managed below.
logistics.agents_hint: Agents (e.g. vans, drivers, or crew) you can assign as the start and end agent on a logistics listing's attendees.
logistics.assigned_users_hint: These users see this agent's deliveries and collections on the deliveries page. Agent-class users can only see the deliveries page; owners and managers reach it from the Calendar menu.
logistics.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete the logistics agent {name}? Any attendees assigned to this agent will have that assignment cleared.
logistics.type_name_to_confirm: Type the agent name "{name}" to confirm:
attendee_logistics.location_hint: The latitude and longitude pin the exact spot on the map. Search by postcode to fill them in, or type them yourself.
attendee_logistics.location_error: Enter a latitude between -90 and 90 and a longitude between -180 and 180, or leave both empty
attendee_logistics.diff_heading: The chosen address differs from what's typed:
attendee_logistics.others_hint: Everyone else with a booking on the same dates. Open one to plan its times alongside this job.
